purpose: Replicate the two-cell S2/eager comparison with an AI lease budget that covers the host-RPC scheduling tail observed in confirm23.

selection_source.confirm23_s2: Three S2 runs had zero AI violations and 728.9-731.6 background units/s.
selection_source.confirm23_eager: One eager run failed closed after a 28.170 ms host RPC delay although the GPU work itself took 0.886 ms; the two valid eager runs achieved 698.4-701.1 units/s.
selection_source.budget_rule: Round the observed host tail upward to a 40 ms end-to-end lease budget and add a 2 ms launch guard.

radio.input: two logical cells share one immutable noisy 273-PRB PUSCH per release

background.kind: separate MPS NeuralRx CUDA Graph client
